As AI in clinical development moves from experimentation to practical implementation, this panel looks at what it takes to scale beyond isolated use cases while balancing innovation with accountability and regulatory expectations. Speakers from Fortrea and PT&R discuss how governance, high-quality data, validation, ongoing monitoring, and keeping humans in the loop build the trust needed for consistent, meaningful results.
